== Title ==
<span lang="ja">もう一周</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">パイロットの能力値をパワー・ハープーンの武器運命数に加える。実際に武器運命数を引く前に使用すること。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「ケーブルいっぱい。いけ、切り離せ！」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[One More Pass]].

'''Lore''' — Cable all the way. Go, cut it loose!

'''Game text''' — Add the pilot’s ability to a Power Harpoon’s weapon destiny. Use this before you actually draw weapon destiny.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
One asterisk precedes the title. Lore translates the harpoon call as filling the cable and cutting loose. Game text is an instruction to play before drawing, matching the English parenthetical.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-onemorepass-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[One More Pass]].</ref>
